config.validation: previous calendar year; expanding training ends before validation; purge final two exchange dates from train and validation

config.universe: daily historical nonfinancial CSI300, known contemporaneous industry, tradable, both fixed neutral BP and cashflow available; same rows for every model
config.candidate_definitions: unchanged BP and CASHFLOW_MARGIN_YTD; legacy full-string industry compatibility only before 2013; prior 2015+ scores must be byte-value identical
config.illiquidity: excluded from model queue by frozen annual coverage failure; no formula repair
config.blend_rule: cross-sectional percentile ranks of base prediction and candidate on the same rows; fixed weights; no selection by blend results
config.selection: Among gate-passing variants choose largest net annual increment; exact ties prefer ADD_BP then ADD_CASHFLOW then ADD_BOTH. None passing means NO_GO and protected periods remain unopened.

qualification.failure: stop candidate, no sign/window/model retuning, lockbox remains unopened

lockbox.entry: qualification winner only; one execution of frozen annual protocol
